No one dies except by Allah's permission at a set time; whoever wants the reward of this world or the Hereafter is given it, and the grateful are rewarded.
Believers should not say, like disbelievers, that the dead would have lived had they stayed; Allah gives life and death, and to Him all will be gathered.
Every soul will taste death and be fully repaid on the Day of Resurrection; whoever is saved from the Fire and enters Paradise succeeds, and worldly life is delusion.
Allah takes souls by night and revives people by day until their term ends; guardian angels watch them until His messengers take them at death, and all return to Him.
The angels take the souls of the disbelievers, striking their faces and backs, telling them to taste the burning Fire for what their hands put forth.
No one before was granted immortality; every soul will taste death, Allah tests people with evil and good, and to Him they return.
When death comes to a disbeliever he asks to be sent back to do righteousness, but it is only words, and a barrier lies behind them until they are resurrected.
The Prophet will die and so will Quraysh, and on the Day of Resurrection they will dispute before their Lord.
Allah takes souls at death and during sleep, keeping those decreed to die and releasing the others for a specified term.
The intoxication of death brings the truth that man was trying to avoid.
Everyone on earth will perish, and the Face of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor, will remain.
No one can bring back a dying soul; those brought near get rest and a garden, the right are greeted with peace, and astray deniers get scalding water and Hellfire.
When the soul reaches the collarbones, the dying one knows it is the parting, and that Day the procession is to his Lord.
